features.description: Real provenance: every dashboard section declares the actual source it renders from (state-snapshot.json / plans.json / inbox.json / supervisors.json / fleet-summary.json). When the canonical projection is active, legacy tasks.json/agents.json/activity.json must not be cited or rendered. Provenance is data on the section, not a hardcoded footer string.
steps: Attach a provenance field (source file(s)) to each rendered section in the state producer
Render provenance from that field; remove the hardcoded legacy footer
Assert legacy tasks.json/agents.json/activity.json are not read when state-snapshot.json projection is active
Tests: each section's declared provenance matches the file it was built from; legacy footer absent under canonical projection
features.acceptance: Every section's displayed provenance equals the file(s) it was actually built from; with the canonical projection active, no section cites or renders legacy tasks/agents/activity.json. Verified by tests asserting provenance==source.

evidence_refs.note: STREAM_PROVENANCE (real source per stream) + LEGACY_SOURCES frozenset
manifest stream entries carry source=STREAM_PROVENANCE[name] as data, not a hardcoded footer
5 passed: provenance==source per stream; no legacy tasks/agents/activity.json cited or written; +139 state-export regression green

features.description: Lifecycle vs activity as separate axes. 'Active Plans' = count of plans with status==active (from plans/state-snapshot). 'Live Now' = count of active supervisors (from dontpanic ps / supervisors.json). Rename the misleading 'Running' label; no label may imply live execution unless sourced from supervisor state.
steps: Source Active Plans from plan status; source Live Now from the supervisor registry
Rename 'Running' -> 'Active Plans'; add a distinct 'Live Now' indicator
Audit all labels for implied-live-execution wording; gate any such label on supervisor-sourced data
Tests: Active Plans==status-active count; Live Now==supervisors count; with 0 supervisors no label reads as 'running'
features.acceptance: Active Plans reflects status==active and Live Now reflects active supervisors, from distinct sources; with zero live supervisors nothing on the board claims live execution. Verified by tests pinning each count to its source.

evidence_refs.note: activity_summary(): active_plans (status==active, enum-coerced) + live_now (len supervisors) from DISTINCT sources + claims_live_execution honesty flag
9 passed: active_plans pinned to status, live_now pinned to supervisors, distinct sources, zero-supervisor claims no live execution

features.description: Freshness + refresh contract: each major page shows generated_at / data age and offers a clear refresh action or command (e.g. the exact `dontpanic dashboard build`/serve trigger), so a stale view is visibly stale and re-fetchable.
steps: Surface generated_at + computed data-age per major page from the state envelope
Add a refresh affordance (action/command) per page; cite the exact command
Flag stale-beyond-threshold visibly
Tests: data-age derives from generated_at; refresh trigger present on each major page
features.acceptance: Each major page shows generated_at + data age and a refresh trigger; a view past the staleness threshold is visibly flagged. Verified by tests over the rendered envelope.

evidence_refs.note: freshness_status(generated_at,now,threshold) -> {generated_at,data_age_seconds,is_stale,threshold,refresh_command}; clock-skew clamped to >=0; 15min default threshold + `dontpanic dashboard build` refresh
5 passed: fresh vs past-threshold stale, custom threshold, skew clamp, manifest block carries refresh command

features.description: Agent attribution: when supervisors are live, render which agent is working which plan / feature / kind of work, sourced from the active-supervisor registry; when none are live, render 'none'. Read-only consumption of the registry — do not redesign it.
steps: Read the active-supervisor registry (ps/supervisors.json) for {agent, plan, feature/kind}
Render per-kind / per-plan attribution when live; explicit 'none' when empty
Reconcile against Live Now (F002) so attribution count == Live Now
Tests: N live supervisors -> N attributions with correct agent/plan; 0 -> 'none'
features.acceptance: With live supervisors the board shows which agent works which plan/kind (attribution count == Live Now); with none it says 'none'. Verified by tests over stubbed registry states.

features.description: Truthfulness invariant tests: rendered labels/counts must equal the source they claim. The render-truth analogue of 001's round-trip invariant. Covers: Live Now == supervisors.length; Active Plans == plans where status==active; Work provenance == the active projection source; stale legacy files cannot override the canonical projection.
steps: Assert Live Now == len(active supervisors) across stubbed registry states
Assert Active Plans == count(plans status==active) across stubbed ledgers
Assert each section's provenance == its real source
Assert presence of stale tasks/agents/activity.json does NOT change the canonical-projection render
Wire into the orchestrate sweep
features.acceptance: Invariant tests prove Live Now==supervisors.length, Active Plans==status-active count, provenance==active source, and that stale legacy files cannot override the canonical projection; a divergent label/count fails the test. Runs in the sweep.

features.description: Bounded architecture-regen daemon in the dashboard/server loop. `dashboard serve` watches architecture-relevant repo paths + docs/plans/** and, on change, runs a BOUNDED auto-regen: debounced against rapid edits, runtime + file scope capped, deferred while an active write/dispatch is in flight unless safe, run out-of-band so failure never blocks the dashboard, and on large repos using incremental/hash-based refresh or marking 'stale, queued'. Engine only — no rendering.
steps: Add a file-watch over architecture-relevant repo paths + docs/plans/** in dashboard serve
Debounce change bursts into a single regen; cap runtime + file scope
Defer regen while an active write/dispatch is in flight unless provably safe
Run regen out-of-band; capture status (fresh|stale|regenerating|failed) + last_generated + source_commit + dirty + last_error to a state file; never raise into the serve loop
Large-repo path: incremental/hash-based refresh or mark 'stale, queued'
Tests: a watched change triggers exactly one debounced regen; failure records 'failed'+last_error without blocking; in-flight write/dispatch defers; bounded scope honored
features.acceptance: Editing a watched repo/plan file causes serve to auto-regen the architecture map exactly once per debounced burst, within capped runtime/scope, deferred during active write/dispatch; a regen failure records failed+last_error and never blocks the serve loop; large repos mark stale/queued rather than thrash. Verified by watch→debounce→regen, failure-isolation, and deferral tests.

features.description: Architecture tab truthful status render. The Architecture tab shows the regen daemon's status (fresh | stale | regenerating | failed), last-generated time, source commit + dirty-worktree marker, and last error — consuming the F001 provenance + F003 freshness contract. The user is shown an operator action ONLY when human input is genuinely required; otherwise the map self-heals silently and the manual `architecture regen` CLI is presented as an advanced fallback.
steps: Render Architecture status (fresh/stale/regenerating/failed) + last_generated + source_commit + dirty + last_error from the F006 state file
Apply F001 provenance + F003 data-age/refresh affordance to the tab
Emit an operator action only when human input is required; else show self-heal status + advanced manual-refresh CLI
Tests: each status renders correctly; failed shows last_error without an action unless human input required; manual CLI shown as advanced only
features.acceptance: The Architecture tab truthfully reflects the daemon's status + last-generated + source commit/dirty + last error; it surfaces an operator action only when human input is required and otherwise presents manual regen as an advanced fallback. Verified by render tests across fresh/stale/regenerating/failed.
